observation.command:
cd /workspace && echo "=== start.log tail ===" && tail -25 /tmp/start.log 2>/dev/null || echo "no start.log"
echo "=== cluster health ==="; curl -s -m 15 http://localhost:9094/id | head -c 200; echo; curl -s -m 15 http://localhost:9094/peers | head -c 200
echo; echo "=== ollama container ==="; docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}' | grep -i ollama || echo "no ollama container"
echo "=== frontend login page ==="; curl -s -m 15 http://localhost:3000/en/login -o /dev/null -w "login HTTP %{http_code}\n"; curl -s -m 15 http://localhost:3000/ | grep -oiE "truspace|<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -3
